title: SealRun submit request
description:
The body of POST /api/v1/harvest-batches/{harvest_batch_id}/seal, table 10.2-B row R26, against the permission dataset_version.create. ONE MEMBER, AND THE ABSENCES ARE THE SPECIFICATION. MOS-UI-130 makes Seal cohort one operator action spanning two platform operations -- sealing the DatasetVersion (MOS-EVID-015, running C1-C7 per MOS-TRAIN-088) and freezing the DatasetSplit (MOS-EVID-028, running L1-L5 per MOS-EVID-034) -- and forbids the console exposing that it spans them. Everything medos/medos/training/curation.py::seal_from_batch needs beyond the batch is therefore server-derived, and each omission below is a rule rather than an oversight:

  assignments / partitions / fractions / seed -- ABSENT. MOS-TRAIN-112 makes assignment a pure function evaluated once; MOS-EVID-028 forbids a seed; MOS-TRAIN-141's cohort resolver 'takes a split id and a partition name and nothing else' because a container that can name its own data can name the test partition. A request body that named a partition would be that container with an HTTP client in front of it.
  stratification_waivers -- ABSENT. MOS-UI-135: the console MUST NOT write a waiver and MUST NOT display a waiver control. A waiver is a governance act with a permanent documentary consequence (MOS-EVID-036, MOS-TRAIN-091), and MOS-TRAIN-115 makes a waiver on L1, L2, L3 or L5 incapable of permitting a training run at all -- so the control would not even unblock the operator it was added for.
  preprocessing_spec -- ABSENT. MOS-UI-137 forbids the console offering to edit the spec in response to a geometry refusal, because widening the spec to admit the training data changes what is served to every patient and it is the cheapest-looking fix on the screen at that moment. The serving spec comes from the capability's registered version (MOS-IMG-045).
  deidentification_status / deid_policy_id / uid_mapping_table_id -- ABSENT. A client-supplied de-identification status is a client asserting that images are de-identified. The gateway's dataset_export consumer class forces clean_pixel_data: true (MOS-DATA-021, MOS-TRAIN-068) and the tenant's profile version is what the platform knows; MOS-EVID-021 makes the UID space a fact about the seal, not a claim about it.
  source_description -- ABSENT. It is the one free-text field that would land, unreviewed, in an immutable (MOS-EVID-013) and undeletable manifest. MOS-EVID-116 keeps the raw institution name out of every manifest and report, and a text box on the seal screen is where one would be typed.
  evidence_kind / envelope -- ABSENT. C7's bound depends on the claim being made from the corpus (MOS-EVID-003's three kinds) and C5's on the declared applicability envelope (MOS-EVID-098); both belong to the capability and the dataset's purpose, and a client choosing evidence_kind is a client choosing which bound it is judged against.
  Idempotency-Key -- OPTIONAL, and recorded as a gap in MOS-API-112 rather than papered over. MOS-API-022 does not enumerate this row. The exposure is bounded by MOS-TRAIN-209, which makes sealing idempotent on CONTENT: re-running after a fix reuses the identity rather than minting a second one for the same bytes.

dataset_id.description: The Dataset the sealed version belongs to, chosen from row 32 rather than composed (MOS-UI-101). Required and never created implicitly: chapter 7 section 7.3.1 makes one Dataset one source and one licence, MOS-EVID-027 requires the licence to travel with every exported bundle, and MOS-EVID-010 uses the custodian as the issuer fallback -- so two collections sharing one row would share a patient-key space they do not share in reality. Recording a licence is a legal act by the site, on the same footing as the TrainingDataPolicy of MOS-TRAIN-073 that MOS-UI-110 keeps off this surface, and the operator this surface exists for selects among the instruments someone else recorded.
